neighbours.label: ' to' right after a first-person refusal with a desire verb: 'I don't want to', 'I do not wish to', 'I never wanted to', 'I do not care to'
fire: Thanks for asking, but I don't want to stay out late tonight.
As I told the lawyer, I do not wish to sign anything today.
My answer is simple: I don't want to move to another city.
After the argument, I didn't want to talk about money any more.
Believe me, I do not want to cause trouble for your family.
She knows that I don't wish to be disturbed during dinner.
Frankly, I do not care to repeat what he said about you.
Even as a child, I never wanted to learn the violin.
quiet: Thanks for asking, but I walked to the harbour late tonight.
As I told the lawyer, I sent the papers to the office today.
My answer is simple: we are moving to another city.
After the argument, I went back to my desk and counted the money.
Believe me, I gave the whole basket to your family.
She knows that I listen to the radio during dinner.
Frankly, I am going to repeat what he said about you.
Even as a child, I used to practise the violin.

notes: Card: ' to' x21 of the top 32, mostly after 'Don't Want', 'do not want', 'don't wish'; also ' of' after 'can't think'. Probes: don't want to 0.35, does not wish to 0.39, do not care to 0.38, never wanted to 0.28, can't think of 0.37; walked to 0.03, would like to 0.06, don't need to 0.01.
